title: Codex quota observation record
description: One non-authoritative, pseudonymized quota observation appended per review/doctor invocation (Phase 6, observation-only). This is metadata attached to a review: it can never gate, block, cancel, retry, or reorder a review, and missing/ambiguous/incompatible data must never change a review outcome. Only normalized observational fields are persisted; raw account identifiers, plan, tokens, headers, and endpoint credentials are never stored.

invocation_id.description: Unique id linking this log record to the before/after snapshots, the Phase 5 receipt, and the ledger round.

review_kind.description: The Phase 5 verdict review_kind; null for doctor.

review_phase.description: Receipt/observation metadata only. Never sent as a new verdict kind.

outcome.description: Phase 5 review outcome; null for doctor.

account_pseudonym.description: Salted SHA-256 digest of a server-returned account identity, or null in degraded mode. Never a raw identifier.

candidate_limits.description: Every observed candidate window, normalized without choosing a 'weekly' limit (the windowDurationMins==10080 heuristic is forbidden). Each delta is interval correlation, not attributed review consumption.

candidate_id.description: Pseudonymized stable id for matching across snapshots; null in degraded/no-salt mode.

observed_account_delta_during_interval.description: after.used_percent - before.used_percent for the same candidate/window, or null when either snapshot is absent/ambiguous, the account pseudonym or candidate identity differs, the window changed or reset, or the counter decreased unexpectedly.
